visual.description: Sticky top navigation bar spanning full width with centered logo, horizontally spaced nav links, and icon controls (search, bag) on the right.
Full-width section with centered headline, subheadline, two CTA buttons, and a large product image with an overlaid pill-shaped 'Watch the film' button.
Full-width section with centered headline and subheadline, with the product image bleeding in from below the next section boundary.
Product image spans the full width with no text, transitioning into the dark MacBook Pro section below.
Full-width dark (black) background section with centered white headline, subheadline, two CTA buttons, and a partially visible product image at the bottom.
Two equal-width cards side by side, each with centered headline, subheadline, two CTAs, and a product image — MacBook Air (light blue) left, iPad Air (light blue) right.
Two equal-width cards side by side — iPhone 17 Pro on black background (left) and Apple Watch Series 11 on light background (right), each with centered text and CTAs.
Two equal-width panels — Apple Trade In on the left with a hand holding devices, carrier deals on the right with multiple iPhones, each with centered text and a single CTA.
Full-width light section with a single large centered headline 'Endless entertainment.'
Horizontally scrolling carousel of media cards (TV shows and music) with pill-shaped CTA labels, spanning full width with pagination dots and a pause control below.
Full-width section with dense small-print legal text in a single column, centered within a max-width container.

Footer with five equal-width columns of stacked text links grouped under bold category headings — Shop and Learn, Account, Apple Store, For Business/Education/Healthcare/Government, Apple Values/About Apple.
Thin bottom bar spanning full width with copyright left-aligned and legal links (Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, etc.) centered, and country selector right-aligned.
